answer.notes: Partial quoted extraction: source quotation limits prevent including every verified requirement; attaching the PDF would allow complete quoted coverage. The 2026 call is used; the webpage also retains 2025 material. Deadline: 14:00 on 4 December 2026. Additional mandatory rules: environmental main activity, documented solvency to deliver the project, execution within 12 months, and a specific activity for the Fundación Unicaja Volunteer Club. Other required initial documents: request letter, project dossier stating the amount, governing-body members' IDs, current governing-body composition, statutes, and the project budget using the portal template. Accounts, audit reports and other supplementary governance/environment evidence are optional scoring material. Further stages include foundation review with possible clarification requests, committee decision by 12 February 2027, project revision within 15 calendar days if awarded less, and agreement signature within one month of notification. Final reporting includes narrative and financial reports. The agreement sets further obligations; its template and the required budget model were not accessible.
